name: Atompunk
eras: aesthetic built retroactively from genuine 1945–1965 design
places: postwar American suburbia and World's Fair exhibitions
garments: not primarily a clothing look — defined mostly through product/interior design (boomerang shapes, starburst motifs)

media.title: Fallout (video game series, 1997–)
media.note: the single biggest modern vehicle for atompunk's visual revival

reacts_against: nothing contemporaneous — it's a retrofuturist look built after the fact, reacting against later, blander consumer design by idealizing the optimistic techno-futurism of the atomic age.
revivals: ongoing through retrofuturist media (Fallout, The Jetsons revivals, mid-century design collecting)

findings: a vivid streak — roughly 33% of the color measured is highly saturated
measured.caveat: Colors measured from Aesthetics Wiki photos as photographed and displayed on screen; actual garments and materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
